methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.aboutText: We help you choose the right place to live. For every neighborhood we show the availability and quality of nearby infrastructure on an H3 hex grid - from schools and shops to transport, quiet and safety. Built for locals and expats looking for the ideal neighborhood. City coverage is expanding over time.
methodology.scoringText: We split the city into H3 hex cells (~150×150 m). For most layers we count objects within 800 m of the cell center (≈10 min walk). Quiet is derived from strategic noise maps (less noise = higher score) and safety from crime density (fewer incidents = higher score). Scores are normalized 0-1 within each city - 1 is the best value in the city, 0 the worst.
methodology.matchText: In “Match me” mode you set how important each criterion is. The map computes a weighted average of all layer scores and instantly colors neighborhoods by how well they fit your priorities. Move the sliders and watch the best-fitting areas update in real time.
